outcome: composite neonatal morbidity (hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, shoulder dystocia, large for gestational age at birth, preterm birth, neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission, perinatal death)
cohort: Pregnant people with type 2 diabetes who received prenatal care and delivered singleton, nonanomalous neonates at a single academic tertiary care center.
finding: Continuous glucose monitoring use in pregnant people with type 2 diabetes was associated with less neonatal morbidity, fewer preterm births, and fewer NICU admissions.
